sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The best knockoffs in the world are in China.
sentences.zh: 世界上最好的山寨货在中国。

sentences.en: Sure, designer handbags and Rolexes, but also really large-scale imitations.
sentences.zh: 当然，包括名牌手提包和劳力士，但也有真正的大型仿制品。

sentences.en: Like fake Apple stores that are so dead-on that employees of the store think they're working in a real Apple store.
sentences.zh: 比如逼真的苹果专卖店，里面的员工都以为自己在真正的苹果店工作。

sentences.en: But beyond just working in knockoffs, many residents of Chinese suburbs live their lives in replica cities.
sentences.zh: 但不仅是在山寨建筑中工作，许多中国郊区的居民也在复刻城市中生活。

sentences.en: Venice's with complete canals and replicas of the Doge's Palace.
sentences.zh: 有带着完整运河和总督宫复制品的威尼斯小镇。

sentences.en: Paris's with Eiffel Towers and Arc de Triomphe.
sentences.zh: 有带有埃菲尔铁塔和凯旋门的巴黎小镇。

sentences.en: They're Chrysler buildings, Sydney Opera Houses.
sentences.zh: 还有克莱斯勒大厦和悉尼歌剧院。

sentences.en: Driving through the suburbs of any city in China, you will find a plethora of fake Versailles, British developments, and Californias all bumping up side by side.
sentences.zh: 驱车穿过中国任何城市的郊区，你会发现大量山寨的凡尔赛宫、英伦风情区和加州小镇并排挤在一起。

sentences.en: Just Shanghai itself has 10 cities all built in the architectural style of different European countries.
sentences.zh: 仅上海一座城市就有10个完全按照不同欧洲国家建筑风格建造的小镇。

sentences.en: So it's possible to travel from Germany to Italy to London in the course of a few hours, provided there's not too much traffic.
sentences.zh: 因此，只要交通不是太拥挤，你可以在几个小时内从德国“游”到意大利，再到伦敦。

sentences.en: Bianca Bosker is the author of the book Original Copies, Architectural Mimicry in Contemporary China.
sentences.zh: 比安卡·博斯克是《原版复制：当代中国的建筑模仿》一书的作者。

sentences.en: And she coined a term for these buildings, duplitecture.
sentences.zh: 她为这些建筑创造了一个新词：duplitecture（拼凑建筑/山寨建筑）。

sentences.en: Duplitecture refers to this nationwide movement taking place in China, whereby people are copying entire cities and towns from Europe and the United States,
sentences.zh: 山寨建筑指的是中国正在发生的一场全国性运动，人们复制欧洲和美国的整个城市和城镇，

sentences.en: life-size or sometimes even bigger than life-size.
sentences.zh: 按原尺寸建造，有时甚至比真人尺寸还要宏大。

sentences.en: These are not theme parks.
sentences.zh: 这些并不是主题公园。

sentences.en: Duplitecture developments are actually living, breathing communities where Chinese families are raising their children,
sentences.zh: 山寨建筑开发区实际上是充满生气的活生生的社区，中国家庭在这里抚养孩子，

sentences.en: living out their lives in a place that looks like Orange County or Paris, but a smack dab in the middle of the People's Republic.
sentences.zh: 在看起来像奥兰治县或巴黎的地方过着日常生活，但它却实实在在地坐落在中华人民共和国的中心。

sentences.en: These buildings are not just novelties like the Pyramid or the Eiffel Tower in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑不仅仅是像拉斯维加斯的金字塔或埃菲尔铁塔那样的新奇玩意儿。

sentences.en: The biggest private property developer in China told me that two-thirds of their residential developments were being built in a European style.
sentences.zh: 中国最大的私人房地产开发商告诉我，他们三分之二的住宅开发项目都是欧式风格。

sentences.en: Nor are they like American Chinatowns or Germantowns, which were established by immigrants.
sentences.zh: 它们也不像由移民建立的美国唐人街或德国城。

sentences.en: These are Chinese communities in American or European style buildings, which are often designed by Chinese architects.
sentences.zh: 这些是中国人风格的美式或欧式建筑社区，通常由中国建筑师设计。

sentences.en: Visiting China's copy of Paris in the outskirts of Hangzhou, I found a place that in some ways was very emblematic of Paris.
sentences.zh: 在参观位于杭州郊区的中国版“巴黎”时，我发现这个地方在某些方面非常具有巴黎的代表性。

sentences.en: You had the Eiffel Tower, you had the Champs-Élysées Square, but there was no new architecture.
sentences.zh: 你有埃菲尔铁塔，你有香榭丽舍广场，但这里没有现代建筑。

sentences.en: Meaning the Chinese weren't interested in duplicating the newer buildings of Paris, just the old classic-looking ones that are iconic of the city.
sentences.zh: 这意味着中国人对复制巴黎更新的建筑不感兴趣，只对那些成为该城市标志的古老经典外观感兴趣。

sentences.en: At the same time, this is really the most brand-new sparkling Paris I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这也是我见过最新、最闪耀的巴黎。

sentences.en: Even though these are intended to be copies, it's pretty much impossible to plop a building onto a completely new environment without modifying it a little, or a lot.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些都是意在模仿的复制品，但要把一栋建筑硬生生地塞进一个全新环境而不做一点或大量修改，几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: Oftentimes, the duplitecture is larger or smaller than a real thing, or different elements or features might be bloated bigger than others.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，山寨建筑比真品更大或更小，或者不同的元素和特征可能被夸大得比其他部分更大。

sentences.en: Sometimes duplitecture gets so twisted and warped until it's a freakish caricature of the original.
sentences.zh: 有时山寨建筑会被扭曲变形，直到成为原版的一个光怪陆离的讽刺画。

sentences.en: One of the interesting twists on this architectural movement has been the creation of mega-high-rises that are built in a Baroque or a neoclassical style.
sentences.zh: 这场建筑运动中一个有趣的转折点是，出现了采用巴洛克或新古典主义风格建造的超高层建筑。

sentences.en: Picture Versailles stretched 20 floors into the air, and you'll have some idea of what's going on.
sentences.zh: 想象一下把凡尔赛宫在空中拉高20层，你就会对正在发生的事情有个概念了。

sentences.en: Developers can take a lot of liberties with duplitecture construction, like making the replicas work in accordance with feng shui.
sentences.zh: 开发商在山寨建筑的建造上可以有很多自由度，比如让这些复制品符合风水学。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, a lot of these duplitecture compounds have rules that actively discourage any type of modification that they think might subvert the simulacrum.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多这样的山寨建筑大院都有一些规定，积极阻止任何他们认为会破坏这种拟像的修改类型。

sentences.en: There are very, very strict rules in place to ensure that Chinese elements or foreign elements don't crop in and spoil the impression of a Paris.
sentences.zh: 这里有非常非常严格的规定，以确保中国元素或外国元素不会混入并破坏巴黎的印象。

sentences.en: And these rules have been set up to preserve the European feel of this development.
sentences.zh: 而这些规定旨在保持该开发项目的欧洲风情。

sentences.en: For example, no hanging laundry outside, no changing the paint, no installing air conditioners, no keeping chickens in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 例如，禁止在室外晾衣服，禁止改变油漆颜色，禁止安装空调，禁止在后院养鸡。

sentences.en: To further create the impression of Paris, there might be a French bakery or a Bastille Day celebration.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步营造巴黎的印象，这里可能会有一家法国面包店或举行巴士底日庆祝活动。

sentences.en: There might be a pub in an Irish town or a Rio Canal network in a knockoff Venice.
sentences.zh: 一个爱尔兰小镇里可能会有一家酒吧，或者山寨威尼斯里会有一个里约运河网络。

sentences.en: As odd and uncanny as these buildings and communities can be, duplitecture is pretty impressive.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些建筑和社区可能显得奇怪而诡异，但山寨建筑确实令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: These buildings go up quickly on a massive scale, and they show no signs of stomping.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑以惊人的规模迅速拔地而起，而且丝毫没有停止的迹象。

sentences.en: Bosker saw new developments popping up around China all the time.
sentences.zh: 博斯克看到中国各地不断涌现出新的开发项目。

sentences.en: But duplitecture is not exactly a new trend.
sentences.zh: 但山寨建筑并不是什么新鲜趋势。

sentences.en: They have a lot of practice doing this.
sentences.zh: 他们在这方面有着丰富的实践经验。

sentences.en: In pre-modern China, you had China's imperial rulers using copycat buildings as a way of showing off their power and establishing their authority.
sentences.zh: 在前现代中国，帝王们就曾利用山寨建筑来炫耀他们的权力和确立他们的权威。

sentences.en: In the 3rd century BC, one of the rulers showed off his conquest of this rival kingdom by recreating their buildings within his own capital city.
sentences.zh: 公元前3世纪，一位统治者在自己的国都内重建了敌国建筑，以此来炫耀他对该竞争对手的征服。

sentences.en: You also had imperial hunting parks, where rulers would import flora and fauna of all kinds to recreate known landscapes within their own domain.
sentences.zh: 你还可以看到皇家狩猎公园，统治者会从各地进口各种动植物，在自己的领地内重现熟悉的风景。

sentences.en: These imperial rulers would copy as a way of showing that they could literally move heaven and earth.
sentences.zh: 这些帝王会进行复制，以此来证明他们真的可以移山填海。

sentences.en: They now possessed this foreign building or place.
sentences.zh: 他们现在拥有了这处外国建筑或地方。

sentences.en: It was theirs.
sentences.zh: 它是他们的了。

sentences.en: And in keeping with that tradition, one of the most copied buildings in China is the very seat of Western power itself.
sentences.zh: 顺应这一传统，中国被复制最多的建筑之一，正是西方权力的核心本身。

sentences.en: The White House is generally credited as being the most copied building in China.
sentences.zh: 白宫通常被认为是中国被复制最多的建筑。

sentences.en: And it's used for everything from hotels to restaurants to courthouses to homes.
sentences.zh: 它被用于各种用途，从酒店、餐馆到法院和住宅。

sentences.en: Just like the White House has a China collection, China has a White House collection.
sentences.zh: 正如白宫有官方瓷器收藏一样，中国也有一个“白宫收藏”。

sentences.en: The different Chinese White Houses serve different purposes, so they've morphed into various permutations.
sentences.zh: 中国不同的白宫服务于不同的目的，因此它们已经演变成各种不同的变体。

sentences.en: But they all have those signature columns and square portico built in the true blue, unique style, wholly original to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它们都有那些标志性的圆柱和方形柱廊，采用真正独特、纯粹源自美国的风格。

sentences.en: of A.
sentences.zh: （美利坚合众国）

sentences.en: I hate to break it to everyone, but that's not an original building.
sentences.zh: 我不愿打破大家的幻想，但那并不是一座原创建筑。

sentences.en: The architect who built the White House based his design on this huge building in Dublin that is now the seat of the Parliament of Ireland.
sentences.zh: 建造白宫的建筑师以都柏林的一座宏伟建筑为蓝本进行了设计，该建筑现在是爱尔兰议会所在地。

sentences.en: The Linster House in Dublin, which in turn has elements of classical Greek and Roman architecture.
sentences.zh: 都柏林的伦斯特宫，而它本身又融合了古希腊和古罗马建筑的元素。

sentences.en: And it pretty much looks like the White House, even though it's kind of gray.
sentences.zh: 它看起来几乎和白宫一模一样，尽管它是灰色的。

sentences.en: It's the gray house.
sentences.zh: 这是“灰宫”。

sentences.en: The Founding Fathers were really into dupletecture as well.
sentences.zh: 国父们其实也非常热衷于山寨建筑。

sentences.en: They were their own form of architectural plagiarists.
sentences.zh: 他们有他们自己形式的建筑抄袭。

sentences.en: And this is so obvious if you've ever seen the buildings that Thomas Jefferson designed.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过托马斯·杰斐逊设计的建筑，这一点就再明显不过了。

sentences.en: They're also covered in columns.
sentences.zh: 它们也布满了圆柱。

sentences.en: He based the Virginia state capitol on this ancient Roman temple, and that design, in turn, has gone on to influence the design of many, many state capitals around the country.
sentences.zh: 他以这座古罗马神庙为蓝本设计了弗吉尼亚州议会大厦，而这一设计后来又影响了全美许多许多州议会大厦的设计。

sentences.en: Some of the greatest hits of American architecture are copies of the greatest hits of ancient Roman architecture, which are now all being copied by the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 美国建筑的一些最伟大杰作，其实都是古罗马建筑伟大杰作的复制品，而现在这些又全都被中国人复制了。

sentences.en: So we did it too.
sentences.zh: 所以我们以前也这么做过。

sentences.en: And North America was ruled by Europeans, so it makes sense that we would have more European-style architecture lying around.
sentences.zh: 北美曾由欧洲人统治，所以我们周围保留更多欧式风格的建筑也是合情合理的。

sentences.en: But we still continue to build these European homages today.
sentences.zh: 但我们今天仍然继续在建造这些向欧洲致敬的建筑。

sentences.en: When Americans build McMansions or buildings that draw from European elements, we're being inspired.
sentences.zh: 当美国人建造麦克豪宅或借鉴欧洲元素的建筑时，我们是在寻找灵感。

sentences.en: When the Chinese do so, they're ripping off.
sentences.zh: 当中国人这样做时，他们就是在抄袭。

sentences.en: They're copying.
sentences.zh: 他们在山寨。

sentences.en: They're con artists.
sentences.zh: 他们是骗子。

sentences.en: And I think that's unfair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很不公平。

sentences.en: You know, we should all recognize that what we're all doing is copying some pretty old buildings because we still find them attractive,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都应该意识到，我们大家所做的一切其实都是在复制一些相当古老的建筑，因为我们仍然觉得它们很有吸引力，

sentences.en: and we still think that they have symbolic significance to our everyday lives.
sentences.zh: 并且我们仍然认为它们对我们的日常生活具有象征意义。

sentences.en: It's easy to scoff at knockoffs of Venice, but these warped mimicries are the start of something new.
sentences.zh: 对威尼斯的山寨货冷嘲热讽很容易，但这些扭曲的模仿却是新事物的起点。

sentences.en: I say this all the time.
sentences.zh: 我总是这么说。

sentences.en: Stealing plus lack of talent equals creativity.
sentences.zh: 抄袭加上缺乏天赋等于创造力。

sentences.en: What I mean there is that in the effort to copy something, your skills or lack of skills or your different experience,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在努力复制某事的过程中，你的技能、缺乏技能或不同的经验，

sentences.en: it mutates the original so that very often you come up with something that's completely new and completely yours.
sentences.zh: 会使原版发生变异，以至于你经常能创造出完全崭新且完全属于你自己的东西。

sentences.en: Copying is totally underrated, and mindful iteration is how good things become great things.
sentences.zh: 复制完全被低估了，而有意识的迭代正是好东西变成伟大东西的方式。

sentences.en: China has actually proven quite successful at turning copies into innovation.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，中国在将山寨转化为创新方面相当成功。

sentences.en: If you look at the Shanghai movement in China, which is this name given for copies of the iPhone, of sneakers, of social networks,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看中国的山寨运动——这个词用来形容对iPhone、运动鞋、社交网络的山寨，

sentences.en: what you find is that oftentimes the copies actually improve on the original in certain ways.
sentences.zh: 你会发现，很多时候这些山寨品在某些方面实际上对原版进行了改进。

sentences.en: China's iPhone knockoff, which I believe is called the Siphone, actually had some features that you couldn't find on Apple's phone.
sentences.zh: 中国的iPhone山寨机（我想它被称为Siphone）实际上具备了一些你在苹果手机上找不到的功能。

sentences.en: You had removable battery, you had multiple SIM cards, all of these things that Apple users actually really wanted and coveted.
sentences.zh: 你可以更换电池，可以使用双卡双待，所有这些都是苹果用户真正想要和渴望的功能。

sentences.en: And here you could find it in this knockoff phone.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，你可以在这款山寨手机中找到它们。

sentences.en: I'm personally fascinated to see how China takes its imitation and turns it into innovation.
sentences.zh: 我个人非常着迷于看到中国如何将模仿转化为创新。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffelman with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的“99%隐形”由埃弗里·特拉夫曼制作，合作者包括凯蒂·明格、萨姆·格林斯潘以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco and produced at the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7地方公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，制作地点位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽市中心的ArcSign办公室，

sentences.en: a comprehensive architectural firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 这是一家综合性建筑事务所。

sentences.en: Speaking of our dear East Bay, yours truly was named best local radio host
sentences.zh: 说到我们亲爱的东湾，本人荣幸地被评为最佳本地广播主持人，

sentences.en: in the best of the East Bay edition of the East Bay Express.
sentences.zh: 入选《东湾快报》的“东湾之最”专刊。

sentences.en: That totally made my day.
sentences.zh: 这简直让我一整天都心情大好。

sentences.en: Thanks, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: The 99PI experience isn't just this episode that you're hearing.
sentences.zh: “99PI”的体验不仅限于你正在收听的这一集。

sentences.en: We're also fascinating on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我们在推特上也很有趣。

sentences.en: You can follow us at Roman Mars, Sam Listens, Katie Mingle, and Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 你可以关注我们：Roman Mars、Sam Listens、Katie Mingle和Truffelman。

sentences.en: We're also on Facebook, Tumblr, Instagram, Flickr, SoundCloud, and Spotify, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在Facebook、Tumblr、Instagram、Flickr、SoundCloud和Spotify上。

sentences.en: But our home on the web is 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 但我们在网络上的家是99PI.org。
